events.name: Gone viral
events.text: Somebody with a lot of followers has posted your {what}. Orders are pouring in while it lasts.
events.over: The fuss over your {what} has died down.

events.name: Undercut
events.text: A rival has listed a {what} for less than yours, and buyers have noticed.
events.over: The rival selling a cheap {what} has sold out. Buyers are coming back.

events.name: Filament shortage
events.text: The suppliers have run short of {what}. It costs half as much again until the next shipment lands.
events.over: {what} is back in stock at its usual price.

events.name: Power cut
events.text: A power cut. Every print that was running has stopped where it was.

events.name: Client gone bust
events.text: {what} have gone into administration. Their contract is off, and the administrators paid what they could for what had arrived.
